title: I-PV: a CIRCOS module for interactive protein sequence visualization
I-PV: a CIRCOS module for interactive protein sequence visualization-Summary

paragraphs.origin_text: Today's genome browsers and protein databanks supply vast amounts of information about proteins. The challenge is to concisely bring together this information in an interactive and easy to generate format.

title: I-PV: a CIRCOS module for interactive protein sequence visualization-Availability And Implementation

paragraphs.origin_text: We have developed an interactive CIRCOS module called i-PV to visualize user supplied protein sequence, conservation and SNV data in a live presentable format. I-PV can be downloaded from http://www.i-pv.org.
